witness.quote: A vehicle shall not be permitted to stand unattended upon any perceptible grade without stopping the engine and effectively setting the brake thereon and turning the front wheels to the curb or side of the highway.
witness.reason: Sloped-road parking can transition into unattended standing while preserving the fixed other vehicle as a separately routed participant.
witness.branch: Engine, brake and wheel preparation across an attendance transition
required_context: Establish vehicle scope, actual engine state, brake mechanics and front-wheel orientation sensing.
Construct highway-side geometry and grade at the parking target.
Establish highway dedication and public vehicular availability.
Record responsible-person location and actions before, during and after departure without equating vacancy with unattended status.
Place and route the other vehicle explicitly; do not infer its relative position or purpose.
Keep the standing interval distinct from actual passenger exchange.
witness.review_method: Agent review of exact law, fixed layout/maneuver/control, actor scope and retained conditional context
